title: Air-fryer mozzarella sticks
subtitle: Mozzarella coated in panko and air-fried until golden with a molten centre.
excerpt: Mozzarella sticks coated in a double layer of panko breadcrumbs and air-fried until the coating is golden and the cheese is fully melted inside. Freezing before cooking is the key step. Makes eight sticks. Serves two.
sourceNotes: Mozzarella sticks are a fried snack widely popular in American and British casual dining from the 1990s onward. Freezing the cheese before cooking is essential in the air fryer version: without it, the cheese melts and leaks through the coating before it can set.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze coated sticks on a tray, then bag. Cook straight from frozen at 200°C for 10-11 minutes.
recipe.batchNotes: Coat a larger batch and keep in the freezer, cooking on demand.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Coat and freeze ,  1 hour minimum, overnight is better. Do not cook fresh.

content.text: Mozzarella sticks only work in the air fryer if the cheese is frozen solid before cooking. Fresh mozzarella melts in less than 2 minutes at 200°C, well before the panko coating has had time to turn golden and set. Freeze for at least 1 hour ,  overnight is better. A double coat of panko (two rounds of egg and breadcrumb) creates a thicker crust that holds as the cheese melts.

items.prepNote: block mozzarella (not fresh ball), cut into 8 sticks about 8 cm long

content.text: Mix {{breadcrumbs-panko}} of panko with {{garlic-powder}} of garlic powder in a shallow bowl. Set up the coating station: seasoned {{plain-flour}}, then {{eggs}} of beaten egg, then the spiced panko. Coat each {{mozzarella}} stick in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing firmly. Repeat the egg and panko coating for a second layer. Place on a lined tray and freeze for at least 1 hour.

Preheat the air fryer to 200°C. Spray the basket with cooking oil. Place frozen sticks in a single layer. Spray the tops generously. Cook for 4 minutes, flip with tongs, spray again, and cook for a further 3-4 minutes until the coating is golden. Serve immediately.

items.symptom: Cheese leaking out before coating turns golden
items.cause: Not frozen long enough, or only one coat of panko.
items.fix: Freeze for a minimum of 1 hour; overnight is more reliable. Two coats of panko are essential.

items.cause: Not enough oil spray or air fryer too full.
items.fix: Spray generously before and after placing in the basket. Cook in a single layer with space between sticks.

items.cause: Basket not sprayed or sticks turned before the coating set.
items.fix: Spray the basket generously and wait the full 4 minutes before turning.

content.text: Air-fryer mozzarella sticks are a quick sharing snack. Serve with marinara sauce, sweet chilli sauce, or a simple tomato dip. Eat within 2 minutes of coming out of the fryer ,  the cheese firms back up quickly and loses the molten stretch.
